title: Senior Engineer/Deputy Manager - Material Handling (Projects & ME)
description: Position Title: Senior Engineer / Deputy Manager - Material HandlingLocation: Satyavedu Job Description: The Senior Engineer / Deputy Manager - Material Handling is responsible for warehouse engineering, material flow architecture, Handling Unit (HU) design, and intralogistics optimization across manufacturing operations. Sitting at the intersection of industrial engineering, warehouse management, and digital automation, this role leverages 2D/3D CAD and digital simulation tools to design lean material flows, model warehouse layouts, and eliminate shop-floor bottlenecks. The incumbent enforces SAP EWM/MM transactional stability (PR, RGP, material movements), implements ergonomic and automated material handling solutions, tracks warehouse SLAs, and applies data analytics to drive continuous productivity and cost-reduction initiatives in an OEM or Tier-1 automotive environment.Key ResponsibilitiesWarehouse Design & Material Flow: Define storage architecture, material handling systems, and lean internal logistics flows across warehouse and assembly shop floors.Handling Unit (HU) & CAD Design: Design and validate customized Handling Units (HUs), racks, and packaging using 2D/3D CAD software to maximize density and protect parts during transit.Digital Simulation & Ergonomic Automation: Simulate shop-floor dynamics to model layout modifications, resolve flow bottlenecks, and introduce ergonomic solutions and automated material handling systems (AGVs/AMRs).SAP, EWM & Operational Governance: Execute SAP MM/EWM transactions (Purchase Requisitions [PR], Returnable Gate Passes [RGP], inventory movements) and maintain 5S, safety, and visual management standards.Data Analytics & Continuous Improvement: Analyze throughput metrics, track warehouse SLAs and cycle times, identify operational bottlenecks, and drive lean cost-saving initiatives (VA/VE, Kaizen).Strategic Business Alignment: Align warehouse engineering projects with long-term Strategic Business Plan (SBP) targets and cross-functional operational goals.Desired Skills & ExperienceEducation: B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Automobile, Production, or Industrial Engineering.Experience: 10+ years of relevant material handling, warehouse engineering, and intralogistics experience within an automotive OEM or major Tier-1 manufacturing facility.Core Competencies: Handling Unit (HU) CAD design, digital material flow simulation, SAP EWM/MM workflows, ergonomic automation, and warehouse throughput optimization.

title: Senior Engineer/Deputy Manager - Fabrication (Projects & ME)
description:
**Position Title:**
Senior Engineer / Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Fabrication (Projects & ME)

**Location:**
Satyavedu

**ob Description**

The Senior Engineer / Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Fabrication (Projects & ME) is responsible for the process planning, industrialization, robotic automation, and technical validation of chassis and frame fabrication lines. Sitting at the core of structural manufacturing engineering, this role leads the development of advanced joining processes (MIG, TIG, Resistance, Laser, and Friction Stir Welding), robotic programming (ABB, Fanuc, Yaskawa), WPS/PQR specifications, and metallurgical validation. The incumbent oversees the complete project lifecycle—from DFMEA/PFMEA design reviews and fixture/gauge procurement to Cpk/Ppk trials, PPAP approval, ergonomic line balancing (MOST), and SBP strategic capacity planning—ensuring high weld quality, safety compliance, and zero-defect mass production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Process Planning & Weld Engineering:**
  Formulate Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEAs, Control Plans, WPS/PQR standards, and torch/parameter sequences across manual and robotic joining lines (MIG/TIG/Spot/Laser).
* **Robotic Automation & Line Setup:**
  Program and commission robotic welding cells (ABB, Fanuc, Yaskawa), integrate automated seam tracking, design ergonomic layouts, and optimize cycle times using MOST.
* **Tooling, Jigs & Fixture Development:**
  Conceptualize, procure, and prove out welding jigs, locators, Poka-Yoke clamping mechanisms, gauges, and Special Purpose Machines (SPMs) with vendors.
* **Metallurgical Validation & Quality Control:**
  Perform mechanical testing (tensile, bend, macro/micro, hardness) and NDT inspections to guarantee weld penetration, structural integrity, and IATF 16949 / ISO 3834 compliance.
* **NPD, APQP & Industrialization:**
  Lead cross-functional trials for New Product Development (NPD), execute ECN updates, drive APQP/PPAP sign-offs, and prove line capability (Cpk/Ppk) for mass production readiness.
* **Operational Excellence & Cost Optimization:**
  Drive VA/VE projects, scrap reduction, setup time optimization (SMED), OEE improvements, and long-term Strategic Business Plan (SBP) budget/capacity projections.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* **Education:**
  B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Metallurgy, Automotive, or Mechatronics Engineering.

**Experience Requirements by Band:**

* **Senior Engineer:**
  3–6 years of hands-on experience independently managing fabrication process setups, NPD trials, and improvement projects.
* **Deputy Manager:**
  9–12+ years of leadership experience driving SBP long-term roadmaps, mentoring engineering teams, upgrading plant technology, and projecting multi-year capital budgets.
